# bintables/sub

> - : `sub`.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/sub.pkg) · translates [std/sub](../std/sub.md)

If the right operand is a small integer or a variable, it is used directly
as the instruction's operand (`when right simple`); otherwise both operands
are computed through `@binop`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when right simple`

```nasm
{left}
sub rax, {right.operand}
```

### `emit`

```nasm
@binop
sub rax, rbx
```

Includes: [bintables/binop](binop.md)
